chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman in her mid-fifties, round kind face, wearing a maroon velvet house djellaba with gold embroidered trim and a cream headscarf
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman in her mid-twenties, long wavy dark brown hair, wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white blouse and blue jeans
chars.SON: a Moroccan young man aged 25, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing an olive-green hoodie and black joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Late evening in a Moroccan family salon after dinner, low table with tea glasses and leftover dishes. MOM firmly holds GIRL's wrist with a big insistent smile, stopping her from getting up; GIRL half-standing, surprised and shy. Seen from the hallway doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, subjects centered, calm background at edges. Flat 2D animated illustration style, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRL at the open front door of a Moroccan house holding her handbag, looking out at a dark empty street at night, hesitant, a wall clock inside shows almost midnight. Face visible, subject centered. Flat 2D animated illustration style, cool night light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan salon with long banquette sofas, MOM gently pushes GIRL back to sit down on the sofa, wagging a finger playfully as if saying you are not leaving tonight; GIRL laughs embarrassed. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible, subjects centered. Flat 2D animated illustration style, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan apartment hallway at night, MOM proudly points to the open door of her son's bedroom, offering it to GIRL; SON stands holding a pillow and blanket, eyebrows raised in surprise; GIRL looks shyly at the bedroom. Faces visible, subjects centered, calm background at edges. Flat 2D animated illustration style, warm light.
